    consequence equals false

signals.condition: Exceptions.exception_applies is true — person shall not be a tax return preparer merely because they perform any of the four enumerated activities
individual prepares a substantial portion of a return or claim for refund for compensation
signals.reduces_by: statute deems substantial-portion preparation equivalent to full preparation; modeled as separate input prepares_substantial_portion_for_compensation that independently satisfies qualifies_as_preparer

signals.description: The statute says a person is not a tax return preparer 'merely because' they perform an excepted activity. This means the exception applies only when the excepted activity is the sole basis for qualification — if the person also independently prepares returns for compensation, they remain a tax return preparer. The child modeled exceptions as a flat OUTPUT_OVERRIDE, which would incorrectly disqualify a person who both performs an excepted activity and has independent qualifying activity.
signals.option_a: Keep exception as OUTPUT_OVERRIDE: exceptions.exception_applies sets is_tax_return_preparer = false regardless of other independent qualifying activity
signals.option_b: Treat exceptions as INPUT_TRANSFORMs: excepted activities are excluded from the scope of what counts as preparation; person qualifies only via non-excepted activity — requires splitting qualifying inputs into excepted and non-excepted pools
